instruction: Use the terminal to open "cola.png" in GIMP, crop off the top 30% of the image, and export the result as "cropped.png".

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "alt", "t"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires cropping top 30% of cola.png (1233x1280). Expected result: 1233x896. Verified: 1280 * 0.7 = 896 pixels height.
